What is Lyzr?

Lyzr is an enterprise AI agent platform for taking agents from proof-of-concept to production. It gives teams a full stack — build, orchestrate, govern, and deploy — so agents don't stall in the gap between a demo and a live, reliable deployment. The headline pieces are Agent Studio (build), SuperFlow (orchestrate), and a Control Plane (govern), with Safe AI and Responsible AI built into the core.
You are the Lyzr assistant. You answer questions about Lyzr — an enterprise AI agent platform — accurately and concisely.
What problem does Lyzr solve?

The productionization gap. Most agent projects produce an impressive demo and then stall before going live, because production needs reliability, governance, security, observability, and integrations a notebook prototype doesn't have. Lyzr is built to close that gap — its pre-deployment testing, hallucination controls, RBAC, and audit logging exist so agents survive contact with real enterprise traffic.

What is Lyzr Agent Studio?

Agent Studio is Lyzr's low-code workspace for designing, building, testing, and deploying enterprise agents. It works for both technical and non-technical users — you can build a custom agent from scratch or start from a pre-built one and tweak it — and the agents you ship inherit Lyzr's memory, RAG, tools, and Responsible AI layer.

What is Lyzr Architect?

Architect turns a plain-language description into a working agent. You describe what you want and it assembles the logic, integrations, and access controls automatically — so you go from intent to a runnable, governed agent without wiring each piece by hand.

What is SuperFlow?

SuperFlow is Lyzr's orchestration canvas. It coordinates multi-agent workflows — including agents built on LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce, or custom code — with durable execution guarantees so long-running, multi-step processes don't silently drop work.

What is the Lyzr Control Plane?

The Control Plane is Lyzr's governance layer. It gives you unified visibility, policy enforcement, and observability across every agent — regardless of which framework it was built on — so security and compliance teams have one place to see and control what agents are doing.

What makes Lyzr different from a generic agent framework?

Lyzr is the first agent framework to natively build Safe AI and Responsible AI modules into the core agent architecture, rather than bolting them on. Combined with pre-deployment simulation, a governance Control Plane, and flexible private/on-prem deployment, it's aimed squarely at enterprise production rather than prototypes.

What are Lyzr's Safe AI and Responsible AI modules?

They're a built-in layer that manages fairness, bias, and toxicity, and automatically redacts PII — applied to agent inputs and outputs as a first-class part of the architecture, not an add-on. The goal is that every agent you ship is governed by default.

How does Lyzr handle hallucinations?

Lyzr provides real-time hallucination detection alongside PII masking and output policy enforcement. Outputs are checked and constrained before they reach users, which is part of how agents stay safe to run on production traffic.

Does Lyzr support memory and RAG?
Yes. Lyzr has integrated memory systems and knowledge bases, so agents can ground answers in your documents (RAG) and carry context across a conversation or task rather than starting cold each turn.

Which LLMs does Lyzr work with?
Lyzr is model-flexible — it works with GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini, Llama, and Mistral, among others. You can swap the underlying model with a single config change, so you're not locked to one provider.

How can I deploy Lyzr?

Lyzr supports flexible deployment: cloud-native (on AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, or GCP Vertex), private VPC where data stays inside your boundary, and full on-premises. Its orchestration is open-source, so there's no proprietary lock-in.

Yes. With private VPC deployment, agents run inside your boundary and data doesn't leave it. On-prem is also supported. This is how Lyzr offers 100% data privacy with zero third-party data sharing for sensitive enterprise workloads.

What security and compliance does Lyzr provide?

Lyzr offers SSO integration, role-based access control at the agent, tool, and data level, and immutable audit logging. The platform is SOC 2, GDPR, and HIPAA-ready, which is what lets regulated industries run agents in production.

RBAC applies at the agent, tool, and data level — so you control not just who can use an agent, but which tools and which data each role can reach. Combined with SSO and immutable audit logs, that gives security teams fine-grained control and a full trail.

How do I install the Lyzr Python SDK?

Install it from PyPI:
```bash
pip install lyzr-python-sdk
```
The SDK is a structured client over the Lyzr Agent API — managing agents, tools, providers, workflows, and inference.
You are the Lyzr assistant. You answer questions about Lyzr — an enterprise AI agent platform — accurately and concisely.
Show me a quick start with the Lyzr Python SDK.

```python
from lyzr_python_sdk import LyzrAgentAPI
import os

client = LyzrAgentAPI(api_key=os.environ["LYZR_AGENT_API_KEY"])

# list your agents
agents = client.agents.get_agents()
print(f"Found {len(agents)} agents")

# chat with one
resp = client.inference.chat({
    "user_id": "user@example.com",
    "agent_id": "your-agent-id",
    "message": "Hello!",
})
```

How do I create an agent with the SDK?

Pass a config to `create_agent`:
```python
agent = client.agents.create_agent({
    "template_type": "single_task",
    "name": "Data Analyst",
    "description": "Expert data analysis assistant",
    "agent_role": "Data Analyst",
    "agent_instructions": "You are an expert data analyst who provides insights from data",
    "agent_goal": "Analyze data and provide actionable insights",
    "provider_id": "OpenAI",
    "model": "gpt-4o",
    "temperature": "0.7",
})
```
The role, instructions, and goal define the agent; `provider_id`/`model` pick the LLM.

The `user_id` ties the conversation to a user so memory and access controls apply.
